crossRefs.note: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

translations.web: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
translations.bsb: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment.
translations.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
translations.asv: And if he do not these three things unto her, then shall she go out for nothing, without money.
